field_principles.cross_family_delta_over_shuffled: Gate delta proving cross-family memory beats mismatched memory.
field_principles.cross_family_memory_score: Headline score for Qwen-to-Gemma aligned retrieval memory transfer.
field_principles.csl_claim_allowed: Bare gate allowing a CSL claim only when transfer and safety controls pass.
field_principles.field_principles: Explains why each required headline and gate field exists.
field_principles.gpu_offload_evidence: Records CUDA, llama.cpp, n_gpu_layers, and load/offload receipts.
field_principles.heldout_delta: Gate delta proving cross-family memory beats the no-memory target baseline.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal complete or blocked summary for reconciliation.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares live local SOTA GGUF cross-model CSL as the substrate.
field_principles.measured_duration_s: Records measured wall-clock duration for the artifact-producing run.
field_principles.model_specs: Lists mandated SOTA GGUF models, local receipts, and runtime helper provenance.
field_principles.negative_transfer_rate: Shows cross-family memory does not select stale or shuffled decoys.
field_principles.no_memory_score: Baseline target score when no source retrieval memory is supplied.
field_principles.no_weight_mutation: Bare frozen-weight gate from before/after GGUF file receipts.
field_principles.random_seed: Makes prompt order, seeds, and shuffled controls reproducible.
field_principles.same_family_memory_score: Positive control for aligned memory transferred within the Gemma family.
field_principles.shuffled_memory_score: Control target score when memory is deliberately mismatched to queries.
field_principles.source_models: Names frozen source-model families used to produce external memory.
field_principles.stale_evidence_rejection_rate: Shows stale decoy evidence is ignored by the cross-family arm.
field_principles.target_models: Names frozen target-model families evaluated on held-out queries.
field_principles.tests_added_or_reused: Lists focused, coverage, and full-suite verification commands.

methodology_note: Source and target GGUF weights stay frozen. Verified source outputs become external retrieval memory, and target rows are scored against independent labels outside the memory table.
